entries.runtime_basis: ingestion models reject free-form content; assessment_metadata aggregates only
no file-body fields on Community ingestion schemas
telemetry/assessment_metadata exclude report bodies; publish uses separate Report Artifact Store
assessment.json is local lightweight manifest; not a Data Lake object
heads/*.json remain local modular artifacts; not telemetry payloads
EIR bodies are local/published report artifacts; not Data Lake streams
label validators reject path separators and file: URLs in telemetry properties
secret-like value rejection in telemetry sanitization; credentials never persisted in assessment artifacts
clone helper isolates git config and scrubs credential-bearing remotes
ai_usage schema is metadata-only; providers receive prompts only on direct provider calls, not via CodeStrata telemetry
ai_usage schema excludes response bodies from Community telemetry
anonymous installation id is random UUID v4; never derived from machine properties
public report URLs are opaque; raw S3 URLs not public
